Roll 1D6 for each model in the target unit. For every 3+ it suffers an automatic wound with S: 5 AP: 0 D: 1; Sunder(2). Can't cause more than 10 wounds in a single activation.

Select one enemy unit within range. Both the caster and the target roll 1D6 and add their Leadership values to their rolls. If the caster's roll is equal or higher, the target unit suffers one Mortal Wound plus one for each point of difference (minimum one damage).

Change the terrain feature type to any combination:
- Normal terrain / Difficult terrain / Dangerous terrain
- No Cover / Light cover / Heavy cover
The target suffers one automatic wound with S: D AP: -4 D: 3; AT(4), Sunder(2).

The caster may heal a friendly <Canoptek> or <Necron> unit for 2 wounds. Dead models may be revived with this ability. Injured models have to be fully healed first.
If the target unit is completely slain but hasn't been removed from the game yet because of Reanimation Protocols, you may heal only 1 wound.
